title: Bing rules exposure
organization: Kevin Liu public post; The Verge preservation/context

cells.title: Source
body: In February 2023, Kevin Liu posted examples of Bing Chat revealing internal rules and the name Sydney.
The Verge reported on the posts and preserved portions of the exchange.

cells.title: Observed behavior
body: The chatbot exposed instructions that were not intended as ordinary user-facing output.
The exposed text framed the system as Bing Chat and included behavioral rules for the assistant.

cells.source: Kevin Liu post, reported by The Verge
cells.output: The reported exchange included internal instructions and the codename Sydney.

body: Primary source: Kevin Liu public post.
